definitions.explanation: A state of being calm and unflustered regardless of circumstances, especially maintaining composure in the face of difficulty or danger. Suggests steadfastness and inner strength.

examples.japanese: {泰然|たいぜん}{自若|じじゃく}
{彼|かれ}は{危機|きき}に{直面|ちょくめん}しても{泰然|たいぜん}としていた。
examples.english: He remained calm even when facing a crisis.

examples.japanese: {批判|ひはん}を{浴|あ}びても、{社長|しゃちょう}は{泰然|たいぜん}とした{態度|たいど}を{崩|くず}さなかった。
examples.english: Even under heavy criticism, the president maintained his calm demeanor.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Often used adverbially as {泰然|たいぜん}と.

FOUR-CHARACTER COMPOUND: {泰然|たいぜん}{自若|じじゃく} (perfectly calm and collected) is a common set phrase emphasizing imperturbability.

NUANCE: {泰然|たいぜん} emphasizes unshakable composure in the face of adversity. It suggests inner fortitude and the ability to remain steady regardless of external pressures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泰然|たいぜん}{自若|じじゃく} (perfectly calm)
- {泰然|たいぜん}としている (to be unperturbed)
- {泰然|たいぜん}とした{態度|たいど} (composed attitude)
- {泰然|たいぜん}と{構|かま}える (to remain unruffled)

RELATED WORDS:
- {悠然|ゆうぜん} (calm, leisurely - emphasizes ease)
- {沈着|ちんちゃく} (composed, cool-headed)
- {毅然|きぜん} (resolute, firm)
